book.name: KOLOSI
book.title: KOLOSI Kolosi mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Taŋgine wamdus kitek te-mayokap

Tane Kuateŋge Kristus te-tina le tane nu ndoŋ tiŋganu taŋaŋ tiŋginaig tukunu kile taŋgine wamdus samba mbolok agaŋ mbolŋge patikap. Kristus nu Kuate ndinam kumamŋge minyo mbili maditaknu mbolŋge minyok minit ta nu tugumŋge patikap.
Taŋgine wamdus kilke te tuku agaŋ kame mbolŋge pati ndaka samba tuku agaŋ kame mbolŋge patikap.
Tane Kristus ndoŋ kumanu taŋaŋ kumnaig sulumba kile taŋgine abo mine maŋau Kristus ndoŋ Kuate tugumŋge kuirok minig.
Siŋgine abo kitek ta Kristus nu tugu. Nu mayok kuwa le tane nu ndoŋ kilŋa ŋak mayok kaŋgaig.

Tane kilke te tuku nzali ambokok taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal sinamŋge minig ta kume serniŋgap. Fare fare pino ndoŋ une maŋau, wamdus kutur, ŋule parak maŋau, am pile ŋayo maŋau, agaŋ ndende kilam tuku piriride wamdus ta ŋakmba kume serniŋgap. Ande nu agaŋ ndende kilam tuku piririte ta nu yabri mbara mbariŋte taŋaŋ.
Wam ŋaigonu ta tuku Kuate tuku gubra taŋgo mbolŋge minit.
Tane mata buk kilke te tuku mbal minmba wam ŋaigonu ta ke likinaig ta
kile tane gubra kagli fir maŋau waŋe pasa fulaiŋ pasa ŋaigonu ta ŋakmba nduiye ŋgumneniŋgap.
Tane wamdus ambokok ta buk kusrekinaig. Ta tuku taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu yabri yabri ndakap.
Kile tane kitek minig. Tane Kuate kila pile mayewap ŋga nu wamdus kitek tane sinamŋge tugu pilna ta lato lato pilmba minit le ka ka tane kumumbi nuŋe maŋau te-purde.

Sine kitek mineg ta Zu le Grik, ŋgaro pikanu le ŋgaro nda pikanu, yamban taŋgo le rawe taŋgo, piro taŋgo le kulat taŋgo sine kise kise mine ndakeg. Sine ŋakmba Kristus ndoŋ ulendika ndindo ndo mineg le nu sine ŋakmba sinamŋge minit.

Tane Kuate tuku mbal minig. Nu tane tuku kume purmba tane kilam tuku maditiŋgina tukunu tane taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu sinaniŋmba raŋgun magenu ŋak minmba ye ye ndaŋgap. Tane ŋgan minmba wamdus bafuk ŋak minmba
ande tuku pitik gubra te ndakap. Suŋgo nu tane tuku mbar sauka gilaiŋgina taŋamba ndo taŋgine taŋgine mbar gilaiŋgap.
Wam magenu sakit ta kume pur maŋaumbi kile-mayokkap. Taŋawap ta wam kame ta ulendika kumumbi mayok kaŋgat.

Sine ŋgarosu ndindo minmba Kristus ndoŋ ulendika nu tuku ŋgamuŋgal mukuk sinamŋge minam tuku Kuate nu sine wikina. Sine wam ŋakmba ke likeg ta ŋgamuŋgal mukuknu maŋau taŋge kulatkuwa. Tane Kuate tuku gare-garekap.

Kristus tuku pasa tane sinamŋge kumuŋganu minwa le tane wamdus kuyar mayenumbi taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu tumka riroŋ pasa sakap. David tuku mune, mune magenu afu, Tukul Guwa tuku mune ta ŋakmba ninde lika wamdus sinamŋge Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgap.
Tane wam afu ke lika ko pasa sakam ŋga tane Suŋgo Yesus tuku nyu idusmba wam ŋakmba ta ke lika nu mbolŋge Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgap.
Ina mam le kiŋo kame tuku pasa
Pino kame, tane Kristus tuku mbal minig ta te-mayokmba taŋgine taŋgo kumnemŋge minap.
Taŋgo kame, tane taŋgine pino kame tuku kume purkap sulumba nane pasa saŋgrinumbi piti ser ndaniŋgap.
Kiŋo kame, tane wam ŋakmba mbolŋge ina mam tuku miŋge dubikap. Suŋgo nu wam ta nzalite.
Taŋgo kame, tane taŋgine kiŋo kame ake sinaŋ sigair sigair ndaniŋgap. Tane taŋawap ta nane wam magenu kam tuku saŋgri kusrede.
Piro taŋgo tuku pasa

Piro taŋgo, tane wam ŋakmba mbolŋge taŋgine gabat tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minap sulumba tane kulatkade mbal am mbolŋge nane nzaliniŋgam tuku ndo piro ndakap. Tane Kuate tuku idusmba wamdus tugusekmbi mara mara pirokap.
Tane wam ŋakmba ke likade ta Suŋgo tuku piroket ŋga gare ŋak pirokap sulumba piro te taŋgo tuku piro ŋga idusmba ke ndakap.
Suŋgo nuŋge tane lafunu tiŋgamŋgat wam ta gilai ndaŋgap. Tane Suŋgo Yesus tuku piro mbal minig. Nu nuŋe mbal wam magenu niŋgam tuku patikina.
Taŋgo ima nu wam ŋayonu kumba minit ta Kuate nu nane ŋakmba lafunu niŋgamŋgat. Nu ande kusrewe nda.
